# §2: IdP, email-domain-mapping, config, CORS-origin) are Java-first the same way. platform:

# a live Go database — the exact strings/JSON are read verbatim from Go
# reference commit (`07184da`+), which the K2 report cites; a live-DB re-dump was not run for this unit.
# Owner ruling 2026-09-25 (backlog item 13): service-account permissions on admin/iam-admin (5 each)
# router-api-auth.md (2026-09-25): platform:router-operator (role + 2 perm rows) and router:view on

# permissions (events/dispatch-jobs/audit-logs) — each application delivers its own outbox.
# row's JSON is hand-edited (not re-dumped) to add `"clientId":{"type":["string","null"]}`, read
# verbatim from Go `internal/platform/seed/event_schemas.go` at `07184da` (`56aea7c`+), which adds
# `optStr("clientId")` to that schema — mirrors the `connection:synced` row above, same reason.

# rows appended for every emitted code. 56 are Go's rows verbatim, dumped from Go's

# Java's, because Java emits more data (`platform:admin:idp-role-mapping:deleted`,
# `platform:admin:oauth-client:previous-secret-revoked`). 23 codes are Java-only, both rows Java's:
# `platform:function:*` (14). Go's 21 codes Java does not emit are not here.

# describe the emitted data carry the corrected forms, read verbatim from 072's new_schema values.
